description: run.changed — topic fulfilment.run, key = run id. A courier's run changed after it was given to them (unassigned: dispatch gave it to another courier; S-151: cancelled — every order on it was cancelled; stops_removed — a cancelled order's stops left it; stops_moved — dispatch moved the stops not picked up yet to another courier).

courierId.description: fulfilment.couriers.id of the courier the change is for
